frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: This is the entrance, traveller. The Goliaths are the wardens here, sworn to protect the Thunderstone's resting place.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: They don't look too friendly. How do we get past them?

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: We'll need to prove our worth. Goliaths respect strength and rhythm. If we can show them our true rock spirit, they might let us through.

frames.heading: Gnork
frames.body: Hail, Wardens! We come seeking the Thunderstone to reignite the heart of Ampliforia. Let us prove our worth through the power of rock!

frames.heading: Goliath
frames.body: Prove your worth, and you may pass. Fail, and you shall be turned away.

frames.heading: Traveller
frames.body: Let's show them what we've got, Gnork!
